info.name: Inventory Management System - New Features
info.description: Run folders 0 -> 8 in order. Variables (ids, dates, token) are filled automatically by the test / pre-request scripts. Change baseUrl if your server is not on port 8080.

exec: const d = n => { const x = new Date(); x.setDate(x.getDate() + n); return x.toISOString().slice(0, 10); };

request.description: A sub category always belongs to one product type (category). Name must be unique inside that type.

item.name: Get sub categories of a product type
Product types with their sub categories (dropdowns)
Delete sub category (refused while products use it)
Add stock (creates batch + vendor bill, pays part now)
Plain payment (only for orders WITHOUT an installment plan)

request.description: Refused with a clear message when the order has an installment plan - use section 6 instead.
Look at: pendingOrders{totalPendingAmount, pendingOrdersCount, unpaidOrdersCount, partiallyPaidOrdersCount, overduePendingAmount...}, customerInstallments, vendorInstallments.

item.name: 6. Customer installments (NEW) - customer pays an order in parts
Create plan - AUTO (3 equal monthly installments)

request.description: Covers the amount still UNPAID on the order. Frequency: DAILY, WEEKLY, FORTNIGHTLY or MONTHLY. The last installment takes the rounding.

item.name: Create plan - CUSTOM schedule (40% / 60%) - use on an order without a plan

request.description: Delete the existing plan first (request below), because an order can have only one plan.
Becomes a normal payment of the order too, so order paid/pending, invoice and dashboard stay correct.
'installmentPending' is filled by the previous request and holds the remaining amount of installment 1.

item.name: Remove plan (only if nothing paid yet)
7. Vendor installments (NEW) - store pays a vendor bill in parts
List vendor bills (sets vendorBillId = newest bill)
Create plan - AUTO (4 equal fortnightly installments)

request.description: Covers the amount still DUE on the bill (what was paid when stock was added is not included).

item.name: Create plan - CUSTOM schedule (50% / 50%) - use on a bill without a plan
Plain vendor payment (refused when a plan exists)
Due installments to pay - next 30 days
Remove plan (only if nothing paid yet)
Create shipment - tracking id AUTO generated (NEW)

request.description: trackingId is NOT sent - the server creates it (TRK + yyMMdd + 6 characters). Customer name / mobile / address are filled from the order.
